svg.title: Agulhas: two separately scoped source descriptions
svg.desc: A reported one thousand kilometre coastal extent and an approximately two hundred kilometre typical core width. Separate scalar descriptions; no geographic edges, area, observation date or annual range. The existing ACT two hundred nineteen kilometre time-mean section result is a different metric.

g.text: Coastal western-boundary extent · existing unranked source variant
Different scope from the broader 27–40°S geographic floor and reference route.
Typical core-width description · contextual literature summary
Dates, layer, edge cutoff and uncertainty unspecified. No annual range.
ACT 219 km is a different time-mean section metric; do not combine as a range.
Original CC BY 4.0 article · OSW scalar summary, not a geographic diagram.
